copy.curiosityHook: Armed with a cosmic blueprint of time's greatest cracks, can this unruly crew outrun the Supreme Being while plundering history's treasures?
copy.description: When six rogue dwarfs burst from his bedroom closet with a stolen cosmic map, young history buff Kevin gets swept into an era-hopping heist across the centuries, pursued by their former master, the Supreme Being.
copy.vibeSummary: Exciting, humorous, and delightfully brisk, this inventive fantasy offers an engaging adventure great for friends or family.
copy.whyWatch: Director Terry Gilliam turns a fantastical time-travel romp into a witty, fast-paced adventure that tumbles delightfully through myth and legend.

allowedMaterial: Young history buff Kevin meets six dwarfs emerging from his closet
Dwarfs are former employees of the Supreme Being with a stolen map of time holes
They loot treasures across historical eras including Napoleon, Robin Hood, and King Agamemnon
The Supreme Being is pursuing them
excludedMaterial: Major third-act confrontations and final fates
Resolution of the pursuit by the Supreme Being
Ultimate outcome of the stolen map or ending sequences
